page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: Frisiam jure, quibus se debere hinc atque
legibus, institutis per multa nunc sæcula
illam magis quàm hanc referens, & Vl-
ad Selverdios, à Selverdiis vicissim ad
nuto veteri vicanorum jure ac libertate,
attribuerunt. Atque hujus in solo, ubi
in dorso inter camporum humilia linguæ
instar se porrigente, sedem habet G R O-
N I N G A nostra, de quâ nunc scribimus
Regio universa ab exitu Lavicæ per
ambages varias, quâ æstuarium se curvat,
quâ Hunesus egreditur, quâ vadum à

page.notes: The left-margin note reads "ȼRONIN" with a reference-like sign before it, and "GA." below; the sign is uncertain, so I wrote "GRONIN GA." without it. The second margin note is three short lines: "Ægeres", "fluuiibus" and "ippofui." The middle word is doubtful and the last word may be "Hippofui"; I have transcribed them as printed without marks because the scan is too small to be certain, but these are the least reliable readings on the page. The place name "GRO-NINGA" is set in spaced small capitals and is split across the line end with a printed hyphen. "Hunesus" is printed with a long s. The first paragraph begins mid-sentence ("vi,") and is a fragment.
